text:
harper: quick round — a few UX/a11y things from the invite drawer usability test. filing here so we can pair up fixes.
leo: list please.
harper: 1) SSO policy tooltip text is ambiguous: it says "Enforce SSO" but users thought that applied org-wide. need clearer copy + inline helper. 2) when removing a role chip quickly the keyboard focus can skip to the audit header. 3) we should add an "Esc to close" hint in the drawer header. 4) role-import CSV error bubbles currently steal focus when they appear; make them aria-live polite only.
mira: repro'd 2) & 4). repro steps for chip: open invite drawer, add role, hit remove twice fast, then Tab. focus lands on page header.
leo: probable cause: breadcrumb component sets autofocus on updates; it races with the drawer's focus-trap. fix: skip breadcrumb focus if drawerOpen. also call focusLock.update() after chip removal.
access-bot: checklist: - set tabindex=-1 on removed chips before DOM removal - aria-live region with role=status for success/errors - link toggle aria-describedby to helper copy - respect prefers-reduced-motion for chip animations
harper: copy proposal for helper (drawer): "Require SSO for new users. Learn more." on org page longer: "Require company SSO for invited users so new accounts authenticate through your identity provider."
mira: design micro-ask: add 2px inset focus ring for chips in high-contrast/forced-colors, increase horizontal padding by 3px in compact mode, and include "Esc to close" in the drawer header (visually hidden text for screen readers too).
leo: patch plan: I'll remove programmatic breadcrumb focus and add a guard; also wire focusLock.update(); mira can do the CSS + figma. harper will lock copy and file docs link.
ci-bot: branch created: fix/invite-drawer-ux-2275  CI running :gear:
harper: assigning: leo (eng) for focus-lock + breadcrumb guard, mira (design) for chip padding + hint, access-bot for regression tests. Target: small patch in next release. Thanks! :thumbsup:
